title: Vanilla: paced technical publishing
summary: Use repeated alignment lines, asymmetric heading/body splits and paced surface changes to explain technical responsibility.
use_when: A technical service or open-source product needs substantial prose, clear ownership and a coherent explanatory sequence.
avoid_when: An operator needs many concurrent controls or a campaign depends on theatrical media rather than reading.
